patches.name: skip-app-hash-check
patches.description: AppHashChecker.36a2c323(Action callback), called by TitleScene. Replaces its first instruction with a branch to AppHashChecker.2e1a74c9, which only invokes the callback. Skips the install-source check, the code hash and the hash upload to the server.

patches.name: title-skip-login-select
patches.description: TitleScene.SetStateSelectLogin(this, toggleIndex) branches straight to SetStateGuestLogin(this), so the login-method popup (guest/membership/Google/Facebook/Apple/Dalcom) never shows.

patches.name: skip-attendance-popup
patches.description: AttendanceAssist.OpenAttendancePopup(this, isChanged) branches to AttendanceAssist.Complete(this, isChanged): the daily attendance popup is skipped (its table ends 2025-04, so it crashed in BirthDayMessage on later dates) and the lobby flow continues.

patches.name: grant-all-permissions
patches.description: NetworkControl.CheckPermission(permission, callback) calls callback right away: the game never asks for (or insists on) phone/storage/media permissions. Every permission request in the game goes through this method. Pairs with the renamed permissions in AndroidManifest.xml (tools/build-apk.py).

patches.name: account-always-exists
patches.description: LoginControl.get_AccountCode: PlayerPrefs.GetString("vjckkjd", "") gets the key itself as default instead of "". A fresh install therefore has a non-empty account code, the title screen goes straight to auto-login and the guest/nickname popups never appear. The server accepts any credentials.

patches.name: login-always-available
patches.description: LoginControl.get_IsLoginAvailable (stored auth object ID != 0) returns true, so the title screen treats the account as usable on a fresh install.

patches.name: no-ad-sdk
patches.description: GoogleMobileAdsScript.InitADX(OnComplete) returns immediately: the ADX ad SDK (and its GDPR consent form) is never initialized. The only caller, SystemControl.Open, passes an empty callback.

patches.name: skip-terms
patches.description: TitleScene.SetStateTermsAndPolicy() branches to SetStateTutorial(), which is what it does when terms were already accepted: no terms/privacy screen.

patches.name: skip-download-confirm
patches.description: AssetControl.OnDownloadConfirm: instead of ViewControl.OpenLocalePopup(53, message, callback), invoke the callback (in x20) with isOk=true, so the 'N MB of resources will be downloaded' confirmation never shows and the download starts right away.

patches.name: no-review-prompt
patches.description: InAppReviewControl.OpenInAppReviewInResultScene(callback) jumps to the 'invoke Action' helper (AppHashChecker.2e1a74c9): the 'rate this game' prompt after songs never shows, the result scene continues.

patches.name: no-dalcom-account-event
patches.description: LobbyScene.SetDalcomAccountEvent() branches to SetStateUpdateNotice(), its next step: the Dalcom account promo popup in the lobby never shows.

patches.name: skip-song-download-confirm
patches.description: InstallMusicAssist.OpenDownloadConfirmPopup(this, md, fileSize) branches to OpenInstallMusicPopup(this, md), what its Download button does: songs that aren't cached yet download without asking.

patches.name: skip-extra-download-confirm
patches.description: AssetDownloader.ShowDownloadPopup (extra resources download): instead of ViewControl.OpenLocalePopup(53, message, callback), invoke the callback (in x22) with isOk=true. Second path of the same confirmation as skip-download-confirm.

patches.name: store-missing-tab-no-crash
patches.description: StoreAssist.Start(type, code=-1): the tab for a store type is looked up with StoreMenuControl's type->code Dictionary<short,short>.get_Item, which throws KeyNotFoundException when no tab of that type exists (e.g. diamonds/packages/headphones/ads after we removed those tabs). Call TryGetValue(type, out display.code) instead (same class, so get_Item's MethodInfo works as the method argument); a missing type leaves code 0, which StorePopup.SetState(short) then resolves through its fallback (see store-fallback-card-packs-*).
patches.asm: ldr x3,[x8]; add x2,x19,#36; bl Dictionary<short,short>.TryGetValue (0x27E4558)

patches.name: store-fallback-card-packs-by-code
patches.description: StorePopup.SetState(short code): when no tab with that code exists, it falls back to the first tab of type 0 (NewBanner, the store home). We removed the home tab (its banners were all real-money offers), so fall back to type 3 (CardPack) instead.

patches.name: store-fallback-card-packs-by-type
patches.description: StorePopup.SetState(StorePopup.TYPE type): when no tab of that type exists, it falls back to type 0 (NewBanner, the store home, which we removed). Fall back to type 3 (CardPack) instead.

patches.name: skip-tutorial-proceed-dialog
patches.description: TutorialAssist.OpenAccountConfirmPopup: the end-of-tutorial dialog 'You are now ready to play ... Do you wish to proceed? (Reset Nickname & Cards / Proceed)' is skipped by calling its callback <OpenAccountConfirmPopup>b__9_0(this, isOk: true) directly, i.e. Proceed. The reset path re-logs in and hangs with our server.

patches.name: hide-buff-button
patches.description: BuffNewMark.Update (the component on the lobby's buff button, which normally toggles its 'new' badge): instead deactivate its own GameObject, hiding the buff button. Buffs come from buff tickets and events, which don't exist offline.
patches.asm: str x30,[sp,#-16]!; mov x1,xzr; bl Component.get_gameObject (0x38B42C0); ldr x30,[sp],#16; cbz x0,ret; mov w1,wzr; mov x2,xzr; b GameObject.SetActive (0x38B6CFC); ret

patches.name: hide-message-button
patches.description: TopView.RefreshMessageButton(isShow): always hide the Message button in the top bar (the post box has no content offline). TopViewControl.UpdateScene calls it per scene.

patches.name: hide-left-menu
patches.description: LobbyView.InitMenus: always take the 'left menu closed' branch (the menu with Mission and Event starts slid out of view), and fetch leftArrowOff.parent.gameObject (the arrow button's frame) instead of leftArrowOff.gameObject, so hide-left-menu-arrow hides the whole button. Both menu buttons are empty offline (missions, event banners).
patches.asm: ldr x0,[x19,#200]; mov x1,xzr; bl Transform.get_parent (0x38BF720); mov x1,xzr; bl Component.get_gameObject; b 0x1A69220 (was: ...; tbz w21,#0,0x1A69220)

patches.name: hide-left-menu-arrow
patches.description: Second half of hide-left-menu: in the 'closed' branch of LobbyView.InitMenus, SetActive(false) instead of true for the left arrow button (its frame, see hide-left-menu).

patches.name: no-artist-pack-download-at-login
patches.description: LoginControl.LoginStep23 callback: if the equipped artist pack isn't fully in the download cache (ArtistPackDataControl.Data.IsInstalledAll), the original downloads it during the loading screen (AssetControl.DownloadArtistPack); that waits for a confirmation that can't be shown there, so the game hangs after Store.getMyArtistPack. Always continue with LoginStep24 instead.

patches.name: hide-popup-shop-button
patches.description: StorePopup.OnBuild: instead of setting the Pop-up Shop button's label text (popupStoreText), deactivate the label's parent, i.e. the button. The pop-up shop only had real-money offers (PopupStoreData is emptied).
patches.asm: ldr x0,[x19,#616]; mov x1,xzr; bl Component.get_transform; bl Transform.get_parent; bl Component.get_gameObject; mov w1,wzr; mov x2,xzr; bl GameObject.SetActive; nop

patches.name: no-restart-after-background
patches.description: SystemControl.CheckRestart() returns false: resuming the app after a long time in the background no longer restarts the game at the title screen (it compared the time since the pause with a limit; the only caller is SystemControl.AppResume). Offline there is no session to refresh.

patches.name: hide-settings-account
patches.description: InfoAccountView.Refresh (the account box in Settings: account/guest info, Dalcom ID, sign in and out, delete account) deactivates its own GameObject instead of filling it in. There are no accounts offline; the buttons were already no-ops (settings-noop-*).
patches.asm: stp; bl Component.get_gameObject; ldp; cbz x0 -> ret; SetActive(false) (tail call); ret

patches.name: hide-parent-helper
patches.description: Helper (in the dead body of InstallMusicAssist.OpenDownloadConfirmPopup, skipped by skip-song-download-confirm): x0 = a component; deactivates its parent GameObject. Used by hide-menu-attendance, hide-menu-notice, hide-settings-account-title and hide-settings-dalcom-id.
patches.asm: stp x30, x19, [sp, #-16]!; cbz x0, ret; bl Component.get_transform; bl Transform.get_parent; cbz x0, ret; bl Component.get_gameObject; cbz x0, ret; mov w1, wzr; mov x2, xzr; ldp; b GameObject.SetActive; ret: ldp; ret

patches.name: hide-menu-attendance
patches.description: TopView.SetMoreButton: instead of setting the Attendance label, hide the Attendance button in the ☰ menu (attendance is skipped offline, the button did nothing).
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x21, #392]; bl hide-parent-helper; nop x5

patches.name: hide-menu-notice
patches.description: TopView.SetMoreButton: instead of setting the Notice label, hide the News button in the ☰ menu (there is no news offline, the button did nothing).
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x21, #400]; bl hide-parent-helper; nop x5

patches.name: hide-settings-account-title
patches.description: SettingPopup.OnBuild: instead of setting the 'Account Settings' title (accountTitle), hide its parent, the section header.
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x19, #296]; bl hide-parent-helper; nop x5

patches.name: hide-settings-dalcom-id
patches.description: SettingPopup.OnBuild: instead of setting the 'Dalcom ID' header (joinDalcomAccountHeader), hide its parent, the Dalcom ID row.
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x19, #304]; bl hide-parent-helper; nop x5
